source_caption:
🎬 Jersey Girl (2004)

Jersey Girl follows Ollie Trinke, a successful New York publicist whose life changes dramatically after the unexpected death of his wife during childbirth. Suddenly left to raise his newborn daughter Gertie alone, Ollie struggles to balance fatherhood with his demanding career. After losing his job, he moves back to New Jersey to live with his father and begins rebuilding his life. As Gertie grows older, Ollie discovers the joys and challenges of being a single parent while forming an unexpected connection with a young woman named Maya. Starring Ben Affleck and Liv Tyler, Jersey Girl delivers a heartfelt story about family, love, loss, second chances, and discovering what truly matters in life.

🎭 Genre: Romantic Comedy • Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 42m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Kevin Smith

✍️ Writer: Kevin Smith

source_details.synopsis: Jersey Girl is a 2004 American comedy-drama film written, co-edited and directed by Kevin Smith. It stars Ben Affleck and Liv Tyler with George Carlin (in his final live-action film appearance), Stephen Root, Mike Starr, Raquel Castro (in her film debut), Jason Biggs and Jennifer Lopez in supporting roles. The film follows a widowed man (Affleck) who must learn how to properly take care of his precocious daughter (Castro) after her mother (Lopez) dies during childbirth. It was the first film written and directed by Smith not set in the View Askewniverse as well as the first that did not feature appearances by Jay and Silent Bob, although animated versions of them appear in the View Askew log
